Survey title: Enquête nutritionnelle anthropométrique et de mortalité rétrospective SMART 2022
Geographic coverage: National, 11 regions + Bamako; plus Rapid SMART in IDP sites (Ségou, Mopti, Gao, Bamako)
Mortality recall period: 90 days from 26 March 2022 (methodology); section 4.3 says about 108 days
Notes: Final report dated 28 November 2022. IDP sites covered by a Rapid SMART component (population group = IDPs in sites). Recall period stated inconsistently in the report.
